question: At 125 beats per minute, a drum machine at 75% swing delays each second sixteenth note by how many milliseconds?
move: Turn a percentage into time before judging how big a nudge is.
trap: Taking 75% as a delay of three quarters of the whole beat.
hint: Swing is a percentage of the time taken by a pair of sixteenths.
steps: A pair of sixteenths fills an eighth: 480 / 2 = 240 ms.
Straight, the second lands at 50% of 240 = 120 ms; at 75%, 180 ms.
